    • unloadAfterCallModel

      public SkillInjector.Builder unloadAfterCallModel(UnloadTarget target)
      Declarative rule for dropping activated ids after every callModel node. Pass UnloadTarget.all() for ephemeral (one-shot) skills, UnloadTarget.ids(String...) / UnloadTarget.matching(java.util.function.Predicate) for selective scopes, or null for sticky (default).

      The configured rule is wired automatically when the injector is passed to AgentExecutor.Builder.skillInjector(SkillInjector).

    • ephemeral

      public SkillInjector.Builder ephemeral()
      Shorthand: unloadAfterCallModel(UnloadTarget.all()). Alias for singleTurn() — kept because "ephemeral" was the working term during design discussion. New callers should prefer singleTurn().

    • singleTurn

      public SkillInjector.Builder singleTurn()
      Recommended shorthand: clear every activated id after each callModel node returns successfully.

      Scope: single call-model-turn (not invoke-scoped, not thread-scoped). If callModel throws, unload does not run.

    • skillBody

    • skills

      public SkillInjector.Builder skills(Collection<? extends dev.langchain4j.skills.Skill> skills)
      Index skill bodies from LC4j Skills (Skill.name() → Skill.content()). Compatible with ClassPathSkillLoader / FileSystemSkillLoader results.
